notes.title: New Project Kickstarter Launch: XOXO Blood Droplets
notes.content:
Hello!

We wanted to pop in and mention that our latest project, XOXO Blood Droplets, is now live on Kickstarter! It is, admittedly, a very different take on creepiness than what Lake of Voices has going on, haha. But we hope you’ll still get a kick out of this new, disturbing game of ours. 

♡♡♡♡♡♡♡♡♡♡♡♡♡♡♡♡♡♡♡

XOXO Blood Droplets is a cute, comedic, and creepy Visual Novel. The goal is to somehow romance a murderous boy without having the crazy dudes you didn't pick (or even the one you did) end your life. It doesn't tend to go well. In fact, usually it's pretty horrific.

[h1][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/gbpatch/xoxo-blood-droplets-a-horror-visual-novel?ref=579240&token=06114986]Kickstarter Campaign[/url][/h1]

[i]XOBD is not suited for a younger audience.[/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31847041/00b0b58ac890234ea376cb1a74cf59bb2dac5744.jpg[/img]


[h1]Story:[/h1]
JB has been attending the fancy boarding school Saint Sara Belle for almost a year now. Along with six others, she’s forced to join an after-school group created for students that are deemed ‘unfriendable’. JB is fine with that, especially ‘cause one of the awful people there is her special someone. It doesn’t matter that he has trouble getting along with people and is a murderer; he’s still perfect to her!

Well maybe.

No matter how many sparkly hearts consume her vision at the beginning, anything can happen in this place. The amount of twisted, winding ways the story can unfold is frightening. All you can count on for sure is that it will be crazy.

[h1]Full Version Features:[/h1]
    -6 Insane Suitors
    -18 Storylines
    -70 CG images
    -150 Endings!
    -Determine your conclusion by making many painful choices Solve your problems with the MC’s charisma or just through violence
    -Partial voice acting for every character by the original talented cast 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31847041/84863e937206c60505c234229a942f695746401d.jpg[/img]

So, yep, it's very different. But we like to think that variety is the spice of life.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31847041/a43a52c8d61b27e3f56ae34e54ae924cee7ceed1.jpg[/img]
